attempts.explanation: Line 28 uses 'paddr != A_ID' instead of 'paddr == A_ID', which makes 'known' evaluate incorrectly for address 0x0C (ID) and breaks address validation for valid registers.

edits.old_text: wire known    = (paddr == A_CTRL) || is_data || (paddr == A_STATUS) || (paddr != A_ID);
edits.new_text: wire known    = (paddr == A_CTRL) || is_data || (paddr == A_STATUS) || (paddr == A_ID);
